notes.title: Bonds of Yachiyo is now available to purchase!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021791/2cb0107a810c809073bc4d6187080566830d76f7.png

Hello everyone!

The day has come for darkness to befall the land: Bonds of Yachiyo is now officially available to purchase! We’re celebrating the release of our first horror game with a special 20% off discount! Thanks so much for your support!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2922180/Bonds_of_Yachiyo/

Trailer:[previewyoutube=sLEV00m6Pkk;full][/previewyoutube]

Immerse yourself in a true horror experience crafted by Aoi Tsuyukusa as you follow the fall of two best friends into a dark, twisted world inhabited by vengeful spirits of the past. Hide and escape from monsters, solve puzzles and find clues to unravel the mystery!

Should you enjoy our games, consider joining us on Discord and following our Steam Publisher Page for all the latest news from Saikey Studios!

More from us:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2693380/Survival_Mission_Z
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2836340/Breakthru/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2820940/Minako_Beloved_Wife_in_the_Countryside/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2924660/Fault__Broken_Promises/

You can also find us on:

This announcement was brought to you with much love from Saikey Studios. Have a great day, and a thrilling time braving the world of Yachiyo!

notes.title: Dream Life in the Country Side is now available to purchase!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021791/d8d61d6318cc5f95acd55a51188e3fbdf7bf44c2.png

We’re overjoyed to announce the official release of Dream Life in the Countryside, developed by Minaduki Cafe! The game is available right now, with a special 20% off launch discount! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3442040/Dream_Life_in_the_Country_Side/

Trailer:
[previewyoutube=VQ_dZZdiBK8;full][/previewyoutube]

A laid-back farming simulator where you play as Lisa, a dedicated farmer by day and a passionate partner of Honoka at night. Work the land, raise animals, and cultivate your relationship. Unlock special scenes as your bond and farm flourish.
